title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Barack Obama Endorses Frontier AI Slowdown Agreement: Former President Obama praises frontier AI lab leaders for agreeing to slow down development pace, calling for broad public governance on AI's societal impact.

Elon Musk Details Grok 4.8 & 4.9 Technical Roadmap: xAI founder confirms Grok 4.8 (2.5T parameter model on custom C++ stack) enters RL this week, with Grok 4.7 matching Opus 5.0 and Grok 4.9 targeting Astra/Fable performance.
DeepSeek Releases Open-Source Agent Harness (dsh): DeepSeek drops deepseek-harness, an open-source framework for building modular coding agents with pluggable sandboxes, tools, and UI loops.

Trump Administration Invokes 1882 Immigration Act Rule: The administration announces a new welfare-restriction rule effective Friday, September 18th to limit green card eligibility for public charges.

items.title: @BarackObama: Barack Obama Weighs In on AI Frontier Governance
items.body: Former President Barack Obama expresses support for frontier lab leaders agreeing to slow down AI development pace, emphasizing that choices between medicine/energy breakthroughs and economic disruption must be made publicly by society.

items.title: @elonmusk & @itslueul: Elon Musk Outlines Grok 4.8 RL & Grok 4.9 Benchmark Goals
items.body: Elon Musk clarifies Grok 4.7 matches Opus 5.0, while Grok 4.8—a 2.5T parameter model built with xAI's custom C++ software stack—finishes base training this week to begin RL. He adds Grok 4.9 will target Astra/Fable-class performance.

items.title: @sauda_coder & @teortaxesTex: DeepSeek Drops Open-Source 'deepseek-harness' Agent Framework
items.body: DeepSeek releases deepseek-harness (dsh), a fully modular framework for building coding agents where models, tools, sandboxes, and UI loops are pluggable via configuration.

items.title: @mark_k & @thsottiaux: OpenAI Team Responds to ChatGPT Desktop App Feedback
items.body: Users discuss ChatGPT desktop app polish while critiquing the separation between Chat, Work, and Codex modes. OpenAI lead engineer Tibo Sottiaux confirms 'We will fix this'.

items.title: @AtriaASI: Atria Unveils Dawn Preview Agentic Foundation Model
items.body: Atria ASI launches Atria Dawn Preview, an open agentic foundation model designed for long-horizon research and engineering tasks requiring verifiable execution outcomes.

items.title: @chetaslua & @unclebobmartin: Claude Opus 5.2 & Token Efficiency Insights
items.body: Developers highlight early testing of Claude Opus 5.2 routing inside Claude Code with auto-iterating evaluation loops, alongside commentary on optimizing agent harness efficiency.

items.title: @MorseReport: Trump Administration Invokes 1882 Act Welfare Rule for Immigrants
items.body: The Trump Administration announces a rule enforcing public charge restrictions under the Immigration Act of 1882 taking effect Sept 18, impacting federal benefit eligibility for green card applicants.

items.title: @ChinaTruth: India Rejects BRICS Currency Proposal to Replace US Dollar
items.body: India formally declines the BRICS proposal to use the Chinese Yuan for bilateral trade settlements, reiterating its policy on monetary independence.

items.title: @ssankar: Palantir CTO Shyam Sankar Criticizes AI Safety Political Ideology
items.body: Palantir CTO Shyam Sankar calls out Effective Altruist technocrats, arguing AI safety rhetoric is being leveraged to restrict technological progress and concentration of control.

items.title: @Leonajardinho: Viral Breakdown Highlights Rising Auto Insurance Deductible Costs
items.body: A viral post detailing high monthly auto insurance premiums combined with steep out-of-pocket deductibles sparks wide discussion on consumer insurance economics.

items.title: @elonmusk & @BrandonLuuMD: Cognitive Study Reveals Gamers Test ~13.7 Years Younger
items.body: A study shared by Dr. Brandon Luu showing frequent video gamers score on cognitive tests equivalent to non-gamers ~13.7 years younger draws a playful response from Elon Musk.

items.title: @NFL & @SportsCenter: Gridiron Action Delivers Viral Highlights
items.body: The NFL and SportsCenter spotlight standout plays including Drew Mestemaker's touchdown leap and 49ers vs Rams netflix broadcast highlights.

items.title: @iMiaSanMia & @FCBayernEN: Harry Kane Leads Bayern Munich Victory
items.body: Harry Kane delivers another match-winning goal for Bayern Munich as teammates praise his world-class scoring form across European competitions.
